Widely practiced in the ULR, Serafin-Dourism can be seen as a mix of religion and determination. The main belief of the religion is that The Holy One would want you to live as prosperous of a life as possible, and that you must face life's challenges head on, and remain focused. It's heavily influenced by native beliefs in the Goddess Serafina, the god of prosperity and fierceness, and the very stoic values of early craftsmen and their families.
